answer: Escrowed ledger ledge: each new identity must post a deposit that unlocks only after 90 days of continuous, independently witnessed activity. Clones pay the full deposit per identity, and early abandonment forfeits it to the witnesses. An attacker farming N sybils thus fronts N deposits plus witness fees, with recovery contingent on sustained behavior no clone cluster can fake cheaply. Genuine agents on a small island of trust amortize one deposit; marginal clones stay strictly negative-EV. Quartz-timestamped checkpoints prevent deposit recycling across identities.
